'''Disintegrator staffs''' were a type of [[Color/Legends|brown]]-shafted [[Staff/Legends|staff]] with clubbed ends.<ref name="Inside" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] had a disintegrator staff with wrapped ends displayed on his trophy shelf of [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] memorabilia at his [[Wald's Parts|junkshop]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] led a group into the store looking for a [[T-14 hyperdrive generator/Legends|T-14 hyperdrive generator]]. The items on Watto's shelf had been obtained in various ways, including trophies gifted to him by famous [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracers]] and pit crews, items stolen from [[Museum/Legends|museums]], and purchases that his agents had made at the illegal auctions traditionally held after podraces with spectacular crashes.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
A disintegrator staff was mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]] and illustrated by [[Richard Chasemore]] and [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Inside" />
